privacy.onDevice: Your drinks, goal and settings stay on this phone. Sipling has no account and no server.
privacy.ads: Sipling shows ads to stay free. Ads use your advertising ID; where the law asks, you choose what is allowed.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.intro: Save your drinks, goal, settings and plant to a file, and bring them back on a new phone. The file only goes where you send it.
backup.exportBody: Creates a file you can save to Drive or send to yourself.
backup.importBody: Pick a Sipling backup file. You will see what is in it before anything changes.
backup.exportFailed: Could not create the backup. Please try again.

errors.invalid: That file is damaged or is not a Sipling backup.
errors.notBackup: That file is not a Sipling backup.
errors.newer: This backup is from a newer version. Update Sipling to import it.

backup.replaceWarning: Everything now in Sipling will be replaced.

battery.intro: Some phones stop apps in the background, so reminders can arrive late or not at all. Three steps usually fix it. Sipling never changes these settings for you.
battery.note: Reminders are approximate: Android may deliver them a few minutes late to save battery.

samsung.1: Open Settings, then Battery and device care, then Battery.
samsung.2: Tap Background usage limits and remove Sipling from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
samsung.3: Add Sipling to Never sleeping apps.

xiaomi.1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Manage apps, then Sipling.
xiaomi.3: Open Battery saver and choose No restrictions.

huawei.1: Open Settings, then Battery, then App launch.
huawei.2: Find Sipling and switch to Manage manually.
huawei.3: Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

oneplus.1: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery optimization.
oneplus.2: Find Sipling and choose Don't optimize.
oneplus.3: In the app's info page, allow Auto-launch if you see it.

oppo.1: Open Settings, then Battery, then App battery management.
oppo.2: Choose Sipling and allow Background activity.
oppo.3: Turn on Auto-launch for Sipling in the app's info page.

google.1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Sipling, then App battery usage.
google.3: Make sure Notifications are on for Sipling.

other.1: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery optimization.
other.2: Find Sipling and choose Don't optimize.
other.3: Look for an Autostart or Background activity switch for Sipling and turn it on.
